apps.name: Klaviyo: Email & SMS
apps.description: Klaviyo loads heavy customer identity trackers, onsite popups, and event listeners.
apps.cleanupAdvice: Remove {% render 'klaviyo' %} or {% include 'klaviyo' %} from layout/theme.liquid and delete snippets/klaviyo.liquid.

apps.name: Loox: Product Reviews & Photos
apps.description: Loox review widgets inject heavy JavaScript and CSS for photo popups and star ratings.
apps.cleanupAdvice: Remove loox liquid tags in theme.liquid and product templates, and delete snippets/loox-*.liquid.

apps.name: Judge.me: Product Reviews
apps.description: Judge.me injects core scripts and widget templates across every page.
apps.cleanupAdvice: Remove {% render 'judgeme_core' %} from layout/theme.liquid and remove judgeme snippets.

apps.name: Yotpo: Reviews & Loyalty
apps.description: Yotpo loads substantial widgets repository bundles that delay First Contentful Paint.
apps.cleanupAdvice: Delete Yotpo snippet files and clean layout/theme.liquid of yotpo script tags.

apps.name: Hotjar: Heatmaps & Screen Recording
apps.description: Hotjar maintains continuous DOM mutation observers to record user sessions, significantly spiking CPU usage.
apps.cleanupAdvice: Locate and remove the Hotjar script tracking snippet inside the <head> of layout/theme.liquid.

apps.name: Microsoft Clarity
apps.description: Microsoft Clarity records user clicks, scrolls, and heatmaps via active listeners.
apps.cleanupAdvice: Remove the window.clarity script block from layout/theme.liquid.

apps.name: Lucky Orange: Heatmaps & Chat
apps.description: Lucky Orange runs recording scripts and chat pollers in the background.
apps.cleanupAdvice: Delete luckyorange snippets and remove tracking code in theme.liquid.

apps.name: Privy: Popups, Email & SMS
apps.description: Privy injects popup overlay scripts and exit-intent tracking libraries.
apps.cleanupAdvice: Remove Privy embed from layout/theme.liquid and remove snippets/privy.liquid.

apps.name: Omnisend: Email Marketing
apps.description: Omnisend loads newsletter forms, tracking tags, and push notification prompts.
apps.cleanupAdvice: Delete omnisend snippets and remove {% render 'omnisend' %} in theme.liquid.

apps.name: WideBundle: Offers & Bundles
apps.description: WideBundle modifies cart and product buy boxes to inject bundled pricing offers.
apps.cleanupAdvice: Remove widebundle snippets and references in main-product.liquid.

apps.name: ReConvert: Post Purchase Upsell
apps.description: ReConvert injects upsell widget triggers on product and thank you pages.
apps.cleanupAdvice: Remove reconvert scripts in layout/theme.liquid and delete snippets/reconvert.liquid.

apps.name: Gorgias: Customer Support Chat
apps.description: Gorgias chat initializes a heavy WebSocket-based widget iframe on every visitor view.
apps.cleanupAdvice: Remove Gorgias chat script from layout/theme.liquid.

apps.name: Tidio: Live Chat & AI Bots
apps.description: Tidio loads live chat bots and customer visitor tracking on page load.

apps.name: Zendesk Chat & Support

apps.name: Crisp: Live Chat

apps.name: Recharge: Subscriptions

apps.name: Bold Subscriptions

apps.name: Shogun: Page Builder

apps.name: Triple Whale: Attribution Pixel

apps.name: Okendo: Product Reviews
